entries: {DISASTER:strikes} hammered {place}, and {first} saw the way out.
{first} turned up {THING:!living,!bulky} {HIDING}, and recognized the coast of {landmark}.
{MESSAGE:physical} from {SOMEONE:human,!plural} reached {first}: come to {landmark} and bring the compass.
{SOMEONE:human,!plural} pressed {THING:portable} into {first}'s hands at {landmark} {MANNER}, and the voyage began.
The {rival} slipped out of {place} {MANNER}, and {first} gave chase.
{SOMEONE:!plural} landed in {place} {MANNER} and offered {first} a share of {PRIZE:material}.
